subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: After the port, should this focused workspace breadcrumb close the broader active-agent/workspace indicator issue, or should that issue stay open for switch feedback and optional identity UI?
rationale: The PR is a narrow implementation slice with closing syntax for a broader product request, so automation cannot choose the final closure scope for maintainers.

options.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Port and merge the breadcrumb, then track optional switcher, prefix, and live-target proof ideas separately.

options.title: Broaden Before Closure
options.body: Require this PR or a follow-up to cover switch confirmation and stronger target-proof UX before closing the linked issue.

options.title: Use Another Surface
options.body: Reject the breadcrumb as the persistent context surface and design the workspace certainty affordance elsewhere in the Dashboard.

recommendation.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Port and merge the breadcrumb, then track optional switcher, prefix, and live-target proof ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged dashboard chrome work makes steipete the best current owner for the header-surface product choice.
